sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，人们在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血液也被抽干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名女尸。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于知道了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now, wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“罪案档案”推介系列的全新力作，现已上线，各大播客平台均可收听。

sentences.en: Hey, have you seen my cat?
sentences.zh: 嘿，你看见我的猫了吗？

sentences.en: Uh, no, sorry.
sentences.zh: 呃，没有，不好意思。

sentences.en: Well, he's at home on my couch.
sentences.zh: 哦，它在我家的沙发上呢。

sentences.en: Here's a picture of him.
sentences.zh: 这是它的照片。

sentences.en: Handsome, isn't he?
sentences.zh: 很帅吧？

sentences.en: Keep your cat safe at home.
sentences.zh: 请把你的猫安全地养在家里。

sentences.en: They'll live 70% longer on average.
sentences.zh: 它们的平均寿命能延长70%。

sentences.en: Message from RSPCA New South Wales with support from the Environmental TruSt.
sentences.zh: 本消息由新南威尔士州防止虐待动物协会发布，并得到了环境信托基金的支持。

sentences.en: Our episodes deal with serious and often distressing incidents.
sentences.zh: 我们的节目涉及严肃且往往令人揪心的事件。

sentences.en: If you feel at any time you need support, please contact your local crisis centre.
sentences.zh: 如果您在任何时候觉得自己需要心理支持，请联系您当地的危机干预中心。

sentences.en: For suggested phone numbers for confidential support, please see the show notes for this episode on your app, or on our website.
sentences.zh: 如需获取保密支持的建议热线电话，请查看您所用应用上的本期节目文稿，或访问我们的网站。

sentences.en: This episode involves a crime against children.
sentences.zh: 本期节目涉及针对儿童的犯罪。

sentences.en: It may not be suitable for all listeners.
sentences.zh: 可能不适合所有听众。

sentences.en: Mrs Cross walked up the driveway of the East Salt Lake City home and rang the doorbell.
sentences.zh: 克罗斯太太走上东盐湖城一处住宅的车道，按响了门铃。

sentences.en: She was counting on the job interview to go well and had dressed to impress.
sentences.zh: 她指望这次求职面试能顺利通过，为此盛装打扮了一番。

sentences.en: Her clothes and make-up were immaculate and her blonde wig was styled neatly.
sentences.zh: 她的衣着和妆容无可挑剔，金色的假发也梳理得整整齐齐。

sentences.en: After a difficult life, this was her chance at a new beginning.
sentences.zh: 经历了艰难的人生后，这是她迎来了新生活的机会。

sentences.en: She wasn't about to blow it.
sentences.zh: 她不打算把事情搞砸。

sentences.en: Mrs Cross was responding to an advertisement in the local paper for a qualified nurse's aide.
sentences.zh: 克罗斯太太是来回应当地报纸上一则招聘合格护工的广告的。

sentences.en: The chosen candidate would provide round-the-clock care and companionship to Alice Sullivan, an elderly woman suffering from Parkinson's disease.
sentences.zh: 被选中的人将为患有帕金森病的德高望重的老人爱丽丝·沙利文提供全天候的照料和陪伴。

sentences.en: Mrs Cross came with glowing references, a thorough knowledge of medications, and a wealth of experience.
sentences.zh: 克罗斯太太带着极力推荐的信函、对药物的透彻了解以及丰富的经验前来应聘。

sentences.en: Alice's son and daughter believed her to be the right person to assist their 86-year-old mother.
sentences.zh: 爱丽丝的儿女们相信她是照顾他们86岁母亲的合适人选。

sentences.en: They weren't wrong.
sentences.zh: 他们没有猜错。

sentences.en: After moving into a spare room in Alice Sullivan's home,
sentences.zh: 在搬进爱丽丝·沙利文家的一间客房后，

sentences.en: Mrs Cross became the best live-in nurse the elderly woman ever had.
sentences.zh: 克罗斯太太成了这位老太太有生以来最好的住家护士。

sentences.en: Kind-hearted and caring, she ensured Alice never went without, even buying her clothing and gifts out of her own pay packet.
sentences.zh: 她心地善良、体贴入微，确保爱丽丝应有尽有，甚至用自己的薪水给她买衣服和礼物。

sentences.en: Despite gentle probing, Mrs Cross never discussed her personal life or history.
sentences.zh: 尽管旁人温和地打听，克罗斯太太却从不谈论她的个人生活或过往。

sentences.en: It was clear that she was deeply religious, as she spent her spare time locked in her bedroom reading the Book of Mormon.
sentences.zh: 显然她是个虔诚的教徒，因为她把空闲时间都锁在卧室里阅读《摩门经》。

sentences.en: In a rare moment of vulnerability on Christmas Day in 1992, she revealed that she had two sons, one of whom had died in a car accident.
sentences.zh: 在1992年圣诞节一个罕见的敞开心扉的时刻，她透露自己有两个儿子，其中一个在车祸中丧生。

sentences.en: That day, she put expensive presents for Alice's granddaughters under the Christmas tree, explaining that she never had any daughters of her own to spoil.
sentences.zh: 那天，她在圣诞树下为爱丽丝的孙女们放置了昂贵的礼物，并解释说她自己从未有过女儿可以娇惯。

sentences.en: Mrs Cross was a loyal companion.
sentences.zh: 克罗斯太太是一位忠诚的伴侣。

sentences.en: She never took time off and told the Sullivans that she considered them family.
sentences.zh: 她从未请过假，并对沙利文一家说她把他们当成家人。

sentences.en: Still, there was something odd about the woman.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，这个女人还是有些奇怪。

sentences.en: The Sullivans couldn't shake the feeling that Mrs Cross was hiding something from them.
sentences.zh: 沙利文一家总觉得克罗斯太太对他们隐瞒了什么。

sentences.en: Nearly 30 years earlier, on July 6th, 1964, Clifford Sanders and his 18-year-old wife, Teresa,
sentences.zh: 近30年前，即1964年7月6日，克利福德·桑德斯和他18岁的妻子特蕾莎，

sentences.en: stood facing one another in the lounge of their cramped, low-set home in the Californian city of Galt.
sentences.zh: 站在加利福尼亚州加尔特市他们那间狭窄、低矮的住宅客厅里面对面地站着。

sentences.en: Sitting in the corner of the room was the couple's 11-month-old son, Howard, playing with his toys.
sentences.zh: 房间的角落里坐着这对夫妇11个月大的儿子霍华德，他正独自玩着玩具。

sentences.en: He was used to the shouting matches between his parents and had learned to keep to himself when they flared up.
sentences.zh: 他已经习惯了父母之间的争吵，并且在争吵爆发时学会了独善其身。

sentences.en: But this time was different.
sentences.zh: 但这一次有所不同。

sentences.en: Minutes later, the doorbell rang at Galt Deputy Sheriff Fred May's house, 200 feet down the road.
sentences.zh: 几分钟后，位于路前方200英尺处的加尔特副警长弗雷德·梅家的门铃响了。

sentences.en: Teresa Sanders was outside cradling Baby Howard.
sentences.zh: 特蕾莎·桑德斯正站在门外，怀里抱着小霍华德。

sentences.en: She tearfully explained that her husband had come at her with an old model hunting rifle, intending to beat her with the butt end.
sentences.zh: 她泪流满面地解释说，她丈夫拿着一把老式猎枪朝她冲过来，企图用枪托殴打她。

sentences.en: Teresa managed to pry the firearm away from her husband, causing it to discharge.
sentences.zh: 特蕾莎设法从丈夫手中夺过枪，导致枪支走火。

sentences.en: Deputy May headed to the Sanders' house while Teresa remained behind, clutching Howard and rocking back and forth.
sentences.zh: 梅副警长赶往桑德斯家，而特蕾莎则留在原地，紧紧抱着霍华德前后摇晃。

sentences.en: She asked over and over if Clifford was going to be okay, hoping that she had just grazed his hand.
sentences.zh: 她一遍又一遍地询问克利福德会不会没事，希望自己刚才只是擦伤了他的手。

sentences.en: When Deputy May entered the Sanders' lounge, he spotted Clifford's lifeless body face up on the floor and surrounded by a pool of blood.
sentences.zh: 当梅副警长进入桑德斯的客厅时，他发现克利福德毫无生气的尸体面朝上躺在地板上，周围是一滩血迹。

sentences.en: A single bullet had shattered the 23-year-old's left wrist, entered his chest, and penetrated his heart.
sentences.zh: 一颗子弹击碎了这名23岁男子的左手手腕，射入他的胸膛，并穿透了他的心脏。

sentences.en: Authorities were well aware of the domestic situation in the Sanders household.
sentences.zh: 当局对桑德斯家里的家庭状况非常清楚。

sentences.en: Two weeks earlier, Teresa had appeared at Deputy Sheriff May's house with bruises around her wrists and neck.
sentences.zh: 两周前，特蕾莎曾出现在梅副警长的家里，手腕和脖子上有淤青。

sentences.en: Clifford had come home drunk, broken a window, and taken his anger out on his wife, who was expecting their second child.
sentences.zh: 克利福德喝醉了酒回家，砸碎了一扇窗户，并将怒火发泄在当时怀有身孕的妻子身上。

sentences.en: Clifford had accused Teresa of infidelity before beating and choking her.
sentences.zh: 克利福德指责特蕾莎不忠，随后对她进行殴打和掐脖子。

sentences.en: Teresa opted not to press charges, and tensions between the couple escalated until their final, fatal confrontation.
sentences.zh: 特蕾莎选择不予起诉，夫妻之间的紧张局势不断升级，直到他们最后一次致命的对抗。

sentences.en: Teresa learned of her husband's fate en route to the local police station.
sentences.zh: 特蕾莎在前往当地警察局的途中得知了丈夫的命运。

sentences.en: Her piercing, devastated screams were heard by street-side onlookers as she was driven away.
sentences.zh: 当她被车带走时，路边的旁观者听到了她凄厉、悲痛欲绝的尖叫声。

sentences.en: In September 1964, the still-pregnant Teresa Sanders faced trial for first-degree murder.
sentences.zh: 1964年9月，当时仍怀有身孕的特蕾莎·桑德斯因一级谋杀罪面临审判。

sentences.en: Her lawyer spoke of the violence she had endured throughout her marriage, including being repeatedly punched, kicked, and burned with cigarettes.
sentences.zh: 她的律师讲述了她在婚姻中所遭受的暴力，包括多次被殴打、踢打以及用香烟烫伤。

sentences.en: An acquaintance recalled the time Teresa had appeared on her doorstep needing a place to stay after escaping from her enraged husband.
sentences.zh: 一位熟人回忆起特蕾莎在逃离暴怒的丈夫后，曾出现在她家门前寻求栖身之所的情景。

sentences.en: Even Clifford's sister didn't want Teresa to end up in prison, but acquitted so she could go home and take care of her children.
sentences.zh: 甚至连克利福德的妹妹也不希望特蕾莎最终入狱，而是希望她被判无罪，这样她就可以回家照顾孩子。

sentences.en: On the stand, Teresa emotionally described how she had fought for her husband's rifle in fear for herself, her son, and her unborn child.
sentences.zh: 在证人席上，特蕾莎情绪激动地描述了她如何为了自己、儿子和腹中未出世的孩子而奋力争夺丈夫的猎枪。

sentences.en: A court-appointed psychologist described her as an anxious, remorseful, and frightened woman who posed no danger to herself or anyone else.
sentences.zh: 一位法院委任的心理学家将她描述为一个焦虑、懊悔且恐惧的女人，对她自己或任何其他人都不构成危险。

sentences.en: After nine days of proceedings, Teresa held her hands to her mouth and visibly trembled as the jury delivered their verdict.
sentences.zh: 经过九天的庭审，当陪审团宣读裁决时，特蕾莎用手捂住嘴，浑身明显地颤抖着。

sentences.en: They ruled that Teresa had acted in self-defence and acquitted her of Clifford's murder.
sentences.zh: 他们裁定特蕾莎是出于自卫，并宣告她谋杀克利福德罪名不成立。

sentences.en: Teresa approached the jury in tears and thanked them while sharing a warm embrace with the female members.
sentences.zh: 特蕾莎泪流满面地走向陪审团向他们致谢，并与女性成员热情相拥。

sentences.en: In March 1965, Teresa gave birth to her deceased husband's child, a girl named Sheila Sanders.
sentences.zh: 1965年3月，特蕾莎生下了她去世丈夫的孩子，一个名叫希拉·桑德斯的女孩。

sentences.en: Not long after, she met and married 18-year-old Robert Knorr.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，她遇到了18岁的罗伯特·克诺尔并与之结婚。

sentences.en: The couple went on to have three children in quick succession.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇随后接连生下了三个孩子。

sentences.en: A girl named Susan and two boys, William and Robert Jr.
sentences.zh: 一个名叫苏珊的女孩和两个男孩，小威廉和小罗伯特。

sentences.en: Teresa stayed at home to look after the five kids while her husband took up work with the Navy, which led him to being away for long periods of time.
sentences.zh: 特蕾莎呆在家里照顾这五个孩子，而她的丈夫则加入海军工作，这导致他长时间不在家。

sentences.en: Then, in June 1969, Teresa filed for divorce, revealing she had once again found herself in an abusive relationship.
sentences.zh: 接着，在1969年6月，特蕾莎提出离婚，透露自己再次陷入了一段虐待关系中。

sentences.en: In her filings, she described the daily threats and acts of great physical violence that Robert Knorr Sr.
sentences.zh: 在诉讼文件中，她描述了老罗伯特·克诺尔

sentences.en: had committed against her.
sentences.zh: 对她实施的日常威胁和严重的身体暴力行为。

sentences.en: A judge granted Teresa the divorce on the grounds of extreme cruelty.
sentences.zh: 法官以极度残酷为由判决特蕾莎离婚。

sentences.en: She was awarded full custody of her children, with the judge citing her fitness as a sole parent as a reason for his decision.
sentences.zh: 她获得了孩子的全面监护权，法官在判决理由中称赞她作为单亲父母的能力很胜任。

sentences.en: For the second time in her life, Teresa found herself without a husband.
sentences.zh: 这是她一生中第二次失去丈夫。

sentences.en: She was also pregnant again.
sentences.zh: 她当时又怀孕了。

sentences.en: In August 1970, 24-year-old Teresa welcomed another child into the world.
sentences.zh: 1970年8月，24岁的特蕾莎迎来了又一个孩子的诞生。

sentences.en: The little girl resembled her mother from the minute she was born, so Teresa named her after herself, Teresa Knorr.
sentences.zh: 这个小女孩一出生就长得像她的母亲，于是特蕾莎以自己的名字给她命名，叫特蕾莎·克诺尔。

sentences.en: Though, she was more commonly known as Terry.
sentences.zh: 不过，人们更常叫她特里。

sentences.en: Two weeks after her 25th birthday, Teresa married railway worker Ron Pulliam.
sentences.zh: 在她25岁生日两周后，特蕾莎嫁给了铁路工人罗恩·普利亚姆。

sentences.en: Although Ron wasn't physically violent,
sentences.zh: 尽管罗恩没有施加身体暴力，

sentences.en: Teresa took his pistol to a friend's house for safekeeping after he threatened to kill her.
sentences.zh: 但在他威胁要杀她之后，特蕾莎还是把他的手枪带到朋友家妥善保管。

sentences.en: This third marriage was also short-lived.
sentences.zh: 这第三段婚姻也同样短命。

sentences.en: By 1972, Teresa went back to being a single mother.
sentences.zh: 到1972年，特蕾莎又回到了单亲妈妈的状态。

sentences.en: When her older children were in school,
sentences.zh: 当她较大的孩子在学校上学时，

sentences.en: Teresa would take their younger siblings to diners and spoil them with ice cream sundaes.
sentences.zh: 特蕾莎会带着年幼的弟弟妹妹去餐馆，用圣代冰淇淋宠爱他们。

sentences.en: There were family outings to the drive-in theatre and along road trips into the Sierra Mountains.
sentences.zh: 有时会有去汽车电影院的家庭出游，以及沿着公路前往山脉的旅行。

sentences.en: When money wasn't tight, Teresa showered her kids with gifts and designer clothes.
sentences.zh: 当手头不那么紧时，特蕾莎会给孩子们送上大量的礼物和名牌服装。

sentences.en: She kept their home in Orangevale, California immaculate inside and out.
sentences.zh: 她将位于加利福尼亚州奥兰治韦尔的家打理得里里外海外表一新。

sentences.en: And all of her children were always polite and well-mannered in public.
sentences.zh: 而且她的所有孩子在公众场合总是彬彬有礼、举止得体。

sentences.en: It was approaching midnight on July 16, 1984, when a carload of people travelled down Interstate 80 out of Sacramento City.
sentences.zh: 1984年7月16日午夜将近时，一车载着人的汽车驶离萨克拉门托市，沿着80号州际公路行驶。

sentences.en: The driver sat alone in the front of the vehicle, scanning the rolling Californian landscape beyond the windshield.
sentences.zh: 司机独自坐在汽车前排，注视着挡风玻璃外起伏的加州风景。

sentences.en: They eventually spotted a quiet, deserted spot within the Sierra foothills known as Squaw Creek.
sentences.zh: 他们最终在内华达山脉山麓找到了一处安静荒凉的地方，名为斯夸克里克。

sentences.en: It was perfect.
sentences.zh: 这里完美极了。

sentences.en: Nestled between two passengers in the back seat was a young woman.
sentences.zh: 在后座的两名乘客中间依偎着一位年轻女性。

sentences.en: She was unconscious and her hands and mouth were bound with duct tape.
sentences.zh: 她处于昏迷状态，双手和嘴巴都被管道胶带绑着。

sentences.en: Once the car rolled to a stop, the woman was removed from the back of the car.
sentences.zh: 汽车停稳后，这名女子被从车后座抬了出来了。

sentences.en: She was laid on a blanket along with her possessions, clothing, a toothbrush, perfume, cutlery, and several pieces of expensive jewellery.
sentences.zh: 她被放在一条毯子上，身旁还有她的财物、衣物、牙刷、香水、餐具以及几件昂贵的珠宝。

sentences.en: A copy of the Jules Verne novel, 20,000 Leagues Under the Sea, and a romance novel were also placed with her, as was a packet of infant diapers, one of which was soiled.
sentences.zh: 一本科幻小说儒勒·凡尔纳的《海底两万里》和一本爱情小说也被放在她身边，还有一包婴儿纸尿裤，其中有一片是脏的。

sentences.en: Gasoline was then poured over her body and belongings.
sentences.zh: 接着，汽油被浇在她的身体和随身物品上。

sentences.en: The driver told their two companions,
sentences.zh: 司机对另外两名同伴说，

sentences.en: I'm going to run back and start the car.
sentences.zh: 我跑回去发动汽车。

sentences.en: You light a match and you just drop it and run.
sentences.zh: 你们划根火柴，扔下去然后跑就行了。

sentences.en: Once the fire took hold, the others raced back to the car where the driver was waiting.
sentences.zh: 大火一旦燃起，其他人便飞奔回司机正在等待的汽车旁。

sentences.en: If you ever tell anybody about this, they warned, you're going to be next.
sentences.zh: 他们警告说，如果你们把这事告诉任何人，下一个就轮到你们。

sentences.en: At around four the following morning, a passing motorist noticed the flames arising from Squaw Creek and contacted the local fire department.
sentences.zh: 次日清晨四点左右，一名路过的司机注意到斯夸克里克燃起大火，于是联系了当地消防部门。

sentences.en: A sheriff's sergeant arrived in the area and observed the small fire from the highway.
sentences.zh: 一名警长中士赶到现场，从高速公路上观察到这处小火灾。

sentences.en: Thinking it had been caused by a lightning strike, he radioed dispatch saying it would likely burn itself out or could wait to be extinguished later that morning.
sentences.zh: 他以为是闪电击中引起的，便用无线电通知调度中心，称它可能会自行熄灭，或者可以等到那天晚些时候再去扑灭。

sentences.en: The sergeant went on his way and gave it no further thought.
sentences.zh: 中士随后离开，没有再多想。

sentences.en: An hour later, a truck driver was heading down Highway 89 when a woman ran from the surrounding woods to flag down his vehicle.
sentences.zh: 一小时后，一名卡车司机正沿着89号高速公路行驶，突然一名女子从周围的树林里跑出来拦下他的车。

sentences.en: She too had observed the minor fire at Squaw Creek and being a local that was familiar with bushfires, she knew something wasn't right.
sentences.zh: 她也注意到了斯夸克里克的小火灾，作为一个熟悉山火的当地人，她知道情况不对劲。

sentences.en: The occurring smoke didn't smell like burning wood.
sentences.zh: 产生的烟雾闻起来不像是木头燃烧的味道。

sentences.en: The truck driver retrieved his fire extinguisher and escorted the woman to the fire's location.
sentences.zh: 卡车司机取下灭火器，陪同这名女子前往火灾地点。

sentences.en: It was contained and easily snuffed out.
sentences.zh: 火势已被控制并轻松扑灭。

sentences.en: As the smoke cleared, the woman examined the remains.
sentences.zh: 随着烟雾散去，这名女子查看了遗骸。

sentences.en: It looks like a mannequin, she said.
sentences.zh: 看起来像个模特，她说。

sentences.en: Squaw Creek was soon swarming with police.
sentences.zh: 斯夸克里克很快就挤满了警察。

sentences.en: The charred remains in the burn pile didn't belong to a mannequin.
sentences.zh: 焚烧堆里的焦黑遗骸并不是什么人体模特。

sentences.en: It was the body of a blonde-haired, blue-eyed young woman wearing a bright yellow hooded sweater.
sentences.zh: 这是一具金发蓝眼的年轻女性尸体，身穿一件亮黄色连帽毛衣。

sentences.en: Aged between 14 and 17, she was less than 5 feet tall and weighed about 115 pounds.
sentences.zh: 她年龄在14到17岁之间，身高不到5英尺，体重约115磅。

sentences.en: She had sustained third-degree burns to 91% of her body, with the fire itself causing her death.
sentences.zh: 她的全身有91%受到三度烧伤，火灾本身是导致她死亡的原因。

sentences.en: Superficial stab wounds to her back and buttocks indicated that she had been tortured, though it was unclear when or how these injuries occurred.
sentences.zh: 她背部和臀部的表浅刺伤表明她曾遭受过折磨，尽管尚不清楚这些伤情是何时或如何造成的。

sentences.en: A one-of-a-kind antique wedding ring was secured around her finger.
sentences.zh: 她的手指上戴着一枚独一无二的古董结婚戒指。

sentences.en: Although the area where the victim had been found was a notorious dumping ground for bodies, the brutality of her murder horrified detectives.
sentences.zh: 尽管受害者的发现地点是臭名昭著的尸体抛弃地，但她遇害的残忍程度仍令侦探们感到震惊。

sentences.en: They examined missing persons, dental and fingerprint records, but were unable to ascertain her identity.
sentences.zh: 他们查阅了失踪人员、牙科和指纹记录，但无法确定她的身份。

sentences.en: She was given the status of Jane Doe, a placeholder name used by authorities when the true name of a person is unknown.
sentences.zh: 她被赋予了“无名女尸”的身份，这是当局在无法得知某人真实姓名时使用的占位名称。

sentences.en: The local sheriff called Jane's murder one of the saddest and most vicious killings in recent history.
sentences.zh: 当地警长称这起无名女尸谋杀案是近期历史上最悲惨、最恶劣的杀戮之一。

sentences.en: A description of the items found at the crime scene was publicly released to help identification efforts.
sentences.zh: 犯罪现场发现物品的描述被公之于众，以协助确认身份的工作。

sentences.en: Most concerning were the infant diapers, with detectives fearing that Jane Doe was the mother of a young child who might be in danger.
sentences.zh: 最令人担忧的是婴儿纸尿裤，侦探们担心无名女尸可能是一个年幼孩子的母亲，而那个孩子可能正处于危险之中。

sentences.en: Yet, no one came forward having recognised any of her things.
sentences.zh: 然而，没有人站出来说认得她的任何物品。

sentences.en: An artist's rendering of Jane depicting a smiling young woman with a chipped upper front tooth also failed to generate valuable leads.
sentences.zh: 一幅描绘了这位无名女尸的艺术家画像显示她是一位微笑的年轻女性，门牙有一处缺损，但这也没能提供有价值的线索。

sentences.en: Eleven months passed and detectives were no closer to formally identifying Jane Doe or her killer.
sentences.zh: 十一个月过去了，侦探们在正式确认无名女尸或其凶手的身份方面毫无进展。

sentences.en: On June 24, 1985, the driver was once again behind the wheel travelling towards Squaw Creek.
sentences.zh: 1985年6月24日，司机再次坐上驾驶座，朝着斯夸克里克方向驶去。

sentences.en: Like last time, it was approaching midnight and they were joined by two accomplices.
sentences.zh: 和上次一样，时间接近午夜，同行还有两名同谋。

sentences.en: There was one notable difference.
sentences.zh: 有一个明显的不同之处。

sentences.en: Their latest victim was already deceased, tucked away in a cardboard box in the trunk.
sentences.zh: 他们最新的受害者已经死亡，被塞在后备箱的一个纸箱里。

sentences.en: It was all planned out.
sentences.zh: 一切都计划好了。

sentences.en: They weren't going to start a fire like they had previously as they didn't want the two crime scenes linked.
sentences.zh: 他们不打算像以前那样放火，因为他们不想让这两个犯罪现场产生联系。

sentences.en: The driver accidentally missed the turn-off to Squaw Creek and decided to continue onwards, looking for another suitable place.
sentences.zh: 司机不小心错过了去斯夸克里克的路口，决定继续前行，寻找另一个合适的地方。

sentences.en: They eventually came to a stop just outside the town of Truckee on the California-Nevada state border.
sentences.zh: 他们最终在加利福尼亚州和内华达州交界处的特拉基镇外停了下来。

sentences.en: The two accomplices emerged from the back seat and collected a shovel each from the trunk.
sentences.zh: 两名同谋从后座钻出来，从后备箱里各拿了一把铁锹。

sentences.en: As they started digging nearby, a police car happened to pull up behind them.
sentences.zh: 就在他们开始在附近挖土时，一辆警车碰巧停在他们后面。

sentences.en: They raced back to the car and hid the shovels, just as an officer approached carrying a flashlight.
sentences.zh: 他们赶忙跑回车里把铁锹藏起来，这时一名警察拿着手电筒走了过来。

sentences.en: The car's three occupants were certain they had just been caught red-handed.
sentences.zh: 车里的三个人确信自己刚刚被当场抓获。

sentences.en: The foul smell of decomposition emanated from the trunk and would no doubt raise suspicions that something was awry.
sentences.zh: 后备箱散发出的腐烂恶臭，毫无疑问会引起人们对有什么不对劲的怀疑。

sentences.en: The officer asked what they were doing.
sentences.zh: 警察询问他们在做什么。

sentences.en: The group informed him that they had pulled over to urinate.
sentences.zh: 这群人告诉他，他们把车停在路边是为了小便。

sentences.en: He then circled the vehicle while shining his flashlight over it.
sentences.zh: 随后，他一边绕着车转，一边用手电筒照着车身。

sentences.en: Speaking directly to the driver, he ordered them to move along and get back on the highway.
sentences.zh: 他直接对司机说话，命令他们离开并回到高速公路上。

sentences.en: The officer had failed to notice the rancid smell, the shovels, or the killer before them.
sentences.zh: 警察没有注意到那股恶臭、铁锹，也没有注意到他们眼前的杀人犯。

sentences.en: They returned to their patrol car and drove off.
sentences.zh: 他们回到巡逻车上并开走了。

sentences.en: The near-miss rattled the trio, who reformulated their plan.
sentences.zh: 这次虚惊一场让三人惊魂未定，他们重新制定了计划。

sentences.en: The driver headed south, where they came across a deserted road near a lake in the middle of bushy mountain land.
sentences.zh: 司机向南驶去，来到丛林密布的山区中一个靠近湖泊的荒凉路段。

sentences.en: The group pulled over, retrieved their shovels, and wasted no time in digging a hole.
sentences.zh: 这群人把车停下，取下铁锹，毫不耽搁地开始挖洞。

sentences.en: The cardboard box was discovered the following morning at Martis Creek Campground by a caretaker clearing trash in the area.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，马蒂斯溪营地的一名管理员在清理该地区的垃圾时发现了这个纸板箱。

sentences.en: It was positioned in a clump of weeping willow trees by the lake.
sentences.zh: 它被放置在湖边的一丛垂柳中。

sentences.en: Curiosity got the better of the caretaker, who tore off the silver duct tape that sealed the box.
sentences.zh: 好奇心战胜了管理员，他撕开了封住纸板箱的银色强力胶带。

sentences.en: When he opened it, a human arm sprung out.
sentences.zh: 当他打开箱子时，一只人手臂弹了出来。

sentences.en: The body of a young woman was tightly packed inside in the fetal position, naked aside from a pair of underwear and white socks.
sentences.zh: 一名年轻女性的尸体以胎儿的姿势被紧紧塞在里面，除了内衣和白袜子外一丝不挂。

sentences.en: She was approximately 20 years old,
sentences.zh: 她大约20岁，

sentences.en: 5 foot 4 inches tall,
sentences.zh: 身高5英尺4英寸，

sentences.en: 105 to 120 pounds, with brown hair.
sentences.zh: 体重105到120磅，留着棕色头发。

sentences.en: The level of decomposition made it impossible to determine much else, including facial features or a cause of death.
sentences.zh: 腐烂程度使得人们无法确定其他任何事情，包括面部特征或死因。

sentences.en: Samples of the victim's teeth, hair and skin were compared to records on file to no result.
sentences.zh: 受害者的牙齿、头发和皮肤样本与存档记录进行了比对，但没有结果。

sentences.en: There were no missing person reports that could be linked to the victim either.
sentences.zh: 也没有任何失踪人口报告可以与该受害者联系起来。

sentences.en: She too was formally listed as a Jane Doe, though trucky locals knew her as the body in the cardboard box.
sentences.zh: 她也被正式登记为无名女尸，尽管当地的卡车司机称她为纸板箱里的尸体。

sentences.en: The killer had gotten lucky.
sentences.zh: 凶手走运了。

sentences.en: The same medical examiner who conducted this autopsy also carried out the one on the Jane Doe found burnt alive at Squaw Creek almost a year prior.
sentences.zh: 进行这次尸检的法医，也是大约一年前在斯阔溪被活活烧死的无名女尸尸检的同一位法医。

sentences.en: The differences between the two crime scenes ensured the examiner failed to determine a connection.
sentences.zh: 两个犯罪现场之间的差异导致法医未能确定它们之间的联系。

sentences.en: Just like the investigation into the first
sentences.zh: 就像对第一起

sentences.en: Jane Doe case, the latest inevitably went cold.
sentences.zh: 无名女尸案的调查一样，最新的这起案件也不可避免地变成了悬案。

sentences.en: Four months later, on October 14, 1985,
sentences.zh: 四个月后，即1985年10月14日，

sentences.en: Gail Smith arrived at a rest stop just outside of the city of Fort Worth in Texas.
sentences.zh: 盖尔·史密斯到达了德克萨斯州沃思堡市外的一个休息区。

sentences.en: The 20-year-old had been given a ride there by her stepbrother, but that's as far as he could take her.
sentences.zh: 这位20岁的女孩是由她的继兄开车送到那里的，但他也只能送她到这里了。

sentences.en: Gail had a 340-mile journey ahead of her to visit her mother in the city of Amarillo.
sentences.zh: 盖尔有340英里的路程要走，去阿马里洛市看望她的母亲。

sentences.en: As she was short on funds,
sentences.zh: 由于资金短缺，

sentences.en: Gail chose to do what she had done many times in the past, hitchhike to her destination.
sentences.zh: 盖尔选择做她过去经常做的事——搭便车去目的地。

sentences.en: She preferred accepting rides from long-distance truckers as she had come to trust them the moSt.
sentences.zh: 她更喜欢接受长途卡车司机的搭乘，因为她逐渐最信任他们。

sentences.en: Gail's stepbrother watched from his car as Gail approached a male trucker with red hair and blue eyes.
sentences.zh: 盖尔的继兄在车里看着盖尔走向一名红发蓝眼的男卡车司机。

sentences.en: After a brief conversation, she hopped into the passenger seat of his cherry-red tractor-trailer.
sentences.zh: 简短交谈后，她跳上了他那辆樱桃红牵引卡车的副驾驶座。

sentences.en: Gail failed to arrive at her mother's and was promptly reported missing, but her fate had already been sealed.
sentences.zh: 盖尔没有到达她母亲那里，并很快被报告失踪，但她的命运其实已经注定了。

sentences.en: The morning after
sentences.zh: 在

sentences.en: Gail had left the Fort Worth rest stop, her body was found poorly concealed in a thicket of bushland near the Canadian River, about 14 miles from Amarillo.
sentences.zh: 盖尔离开沃思堡休息区后的第二天早上，她的尸体在距离阿马里洛约14英里处加拿大河附近的灌木丛中被发现，掩盖得并不好。

sentences.en: Her hands were bound by duct tape and she had been taped tightly into the fetal position.
sentences.zh: 她的双手被强力胶带捆绑，并被紧紧用胶带缠成胎儿的姿势。

sentences.en: She had been hit over the head with a blunt object, raped, and then strangled to death with a man's necktie.
sentences.zh: 她的头部遭到钝器击打，遭到强奸，然后用一条男士领带勒死。

sentences.en: Although Gail's stepbrother hadn't written down the license plate of the truck that Gail had hitched her final ride in, he did recall the make of the vehicle
sentences.zh: 尽管盖尔的继兄没有记下盖尔搭乘最后一趟便车的卡车车牌号，但他确实记得该车辆的品牌

sentences.en: as well as a description of its driver.
sentences.zh: 以及对司机的描述。

sentences.en: Most importantly, he recalled two words emblazoned on the driver's side door.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，他记得司机侧车门上醒目地印着两个字。

sentences.en: Jewett Scott
sentences.zh: 杰威特·斯科特

sentences.en: Jewett Scott was a trucking firm based in Oklahoma.
sentences.zh: 杰威特·斯科特是一家总部位于俄克拉荷马州的货运公司。

sentences.en: The company examined their records and provided the name of the only employee who had been in the Fort Worth area at the time
sentences.zh: 该公司检查了他们的记录，并提供了当时唯一在沃思堡地区活动的员工的名字

sentences.en: Gail Smith had gotten a ride.
sentences.zh: 当时盖尔·史密斯搭了车。

sentences.en: Forty-two-year-old
sentences.zh: 四十二岁的

sentences.en: Benjamin Boyle, better known as Herbert, had a violent criminal history.
sentences.zh: 本杰明·博伊尔，更为人所知的名字是赫伯特，有着暴力的犯罪历史。

sentences.en: Six years earlier, in 1979, he tried to abduct a woman by forcing her into his car.
sentences.zh: 六年前，即1979年，他试图强行将一名女性塞进自己的车里将其绑架。

sentences.en: Boyle pleaded guilty for attempted kidnap and was sentenced to five years probation.
sentences.zh: 博伊尔对企图绑架罪表示认罪，并被判处五年缓刑。

sentences.en: At the time of Gail Smith's murder, he was on the run from a rape that he had committed in Colorado.
sentences.zh: 在盖尔·史密斯被谋杀时，他正在逃避他在科罗拉多州犯下的一起强奸案。

sentences.en: Boyle, who introduced himself as Mr Whipple to women he was attracted to, had secured a load earlier that morning and was headed to a town
sentences.zh: 博伊尔向他有好感的女性自称惠普尔先生，他在那天早上早些时候装载了一批货物，正前往一个镇子

sentences.en: 60 miles north of Houston.
sentences.zh: 位于休斯顿以北60英里处。

sentences.en: Detectives sped down Highway 59 and caught up to Boyle's truck.
sentences.zh: 侦探们沿着59号公路疾驰，追上了博伊尔的卡车。

sentences.en: Boyle admitted to giving Gail Smith a ride but said he had dropped her off at a truck stop in Wichita Falls,
sentences.zh: 博伊尔承认让盖尔·史密斯搭了便车，但称他在威奇托福尔斯的一个卡车休息站把她放下，

sentences.en: 250 miles short of her destination.
sentences.zh: 距离她的目的地还差250英里。

sentences.en: Yet, the case against
sentences.zh: 然而，针对

sentences.en: Herbert Boyle was sealed almost immediately.
sentences.zh: 赫伯特·博伊尔的案件很快就铁证如山了。

sentences.en: His truck contained some of Gail's possessions and her blood and hair were found in the vehicle's cab.
sentences.zh: 他的卡车里装有一些盖尔的财物，并且在车辆驾驶室里找到了她的血迹和头发。

sentences.en: Carpet fibres from the truck's interior matched those found on Gail's remains.
sentences.zh: 卡车内部的地毯纤维与盖尔遗体上发现的一致。

sentences.en: Finally,
sentences.zh: 最后，

sentences.en: Boyle's fingerprints were lifted from the duct tape used to restrain Gail, with the role itself discovered in his truck.
sentences.zh: 在用于捆绑盖尔的强力胶带上提取到了博伊尔的指纹，而胶带卷本身就是在他的卡车里被发现的。

sentences.en: In early November

sentences.zh: 11月初，

sentences.en: Herbert Boyle was indicted for the aggravated sexual assault and capital murder of Gail Smith.
sentences.zh: 赫伯特·博伊尔因加重性侵犯和谋杀盖尔·史密斯而被起诉。

sentences.en: Given his criminal history and transient job, detectives re-examined other unsolved murders to see whether they could be linked to Boyle.
sentences.zh: 鉴于他的犯罪记录和流动性工作，侦探们重新审视了其他未破谋杀案，以看它们是否能与博伊尔联系起来。

sentences.en: One case that drew their attention involved a young woman known only as Jane Doe, found buried in a cardboard box at Martis Creek campground.
sentences.zh: 其中一个引起他们注意的案件涉及一名年轻女性，仅被称为无名女尸，被发现埋在马蒂斯溪营地的一个纸板箱里。

sentences.en: Her murder bore striking similarities to that of Gail Smith.
sentences.zh: 她的谋杀案与盖尔·史密斯的谋杀案惊人地相似。

sentences.en: Both women were found off a highway and near water.
sentences.zh: 两名女性都被发现在公路旁且靠近水域的地方。

sentences.en: They were bound with silver duct tape, placed in the fetal position, and were discovered in a state of undress.
sentences.zh: 她们都被银色强力胶带捆绑，呈胎儿姿势放置，被发现时衣衫不整。

sentences.en: By delving into Herbert Boyle's travel logbook, receipts, and maps, it was discovered that he had been in the Truckee area at the time of Jane Doe's murder.
sentences.zh: 通过深入查阅赫伯特·博伊尔的行程日志、收据和地图，人们发现他在无名女尸被谋杀时曾在特拉基地区。

sentences.en: Additionally, a foreign fibre on Jane's body matched a blanket from Boyle's house in Oklahoma.
sentences.zh: 此外，死者身上的一根外来纤维与博伊尔在俄克拉荷马州家中的一条毯子相符。

sentences.en: There was also a rope fibre found at the crime scene that matched a length of rope in Boyle's truck.
sentences.zh: 在犯罪现场还发现了一根绳索纤维，与博伊尔卡车内的一段绳索相匹配。

sentences.en: Herbert Boyle only faced trial for Gail Smith's murder.
sentences.zh: 赫伯特·博伊尔仅因谋杀盖尔·史密斯一案受审。

sentences.en: In court, he was depicted as mean and unlikable with perverted sexual urges.
sentences.zh: 在法庭上，他被描述为刻薄、令人讨厌且具有变态性冲动的人。

sentences.en: His wife and daughter expressed their concerns that Boyle would harm them if he should be found not guilty.
sentences.zh: 他的妻子和女儿表达了她们的担忧，如果博伊尔被判无罪，他会伤害她们。

sentences.en: His daughter told the court,
sentences.zh: 他的女儿在法庭上说：

sentences.en: I'm very scared of the man right now, and I have been for some time.
sentences.zh: 我现在非常害怕这个人，而且这种恐惧已经持续了一段时间。

sentences.en: After deliberating for 20 minutes, the jury found Boyle guilty of the rape, kidnapping, and murder of Gail Smith.
sentences.zh: 经过20分钟的审议，陪审团裁定博伊尔强奸、绑架和谋杀盖尔·史密斯罪名成立。

sentences.en: He was sentenced to death.
sentences.zh: 他被判处死刑。

sentences.en: Although the body in the cardboard box case never went to trial due to lack of evidence, authorities safely assumed that Herbert Boyle was responsible for her murder also.
sentences.zh: 尽管纸板箱里的尸体案由于缺乏证据而从未开庭审理，但当局完全有理由认为赫伯特·博伊尔也对她的谋杀负有责任。

sentences.en: They were wrong.

sentences.zh: 特蕾莎对储藏室里女儿的尸体置之不理长达三天。

sentences.en: Then on June 24, 1985, she was compelled to act when the smell of decomposition began to permeate through the apartment.
sentences.zh: 直到1985年6月24日，当公寓里开始弥漫出腐烂的气味时，她才不得不采取行动。

sentences.en: Teresa donned some rubber gloves, sat on her bed, and carefully picked off every hair she could see on a set of pink pillowcases.
sentences.zh: 特蕾莎戴上橡胶手套，坐在床上，仔细拔掉一套粉红色枕套上所有能看到的头发。

sentences.en: She then lined the inside of a cardboard box with the pillowcases, before ordering William and Robert to retrieve Sheila's body.
sentences.zh: 然后，她用这些枕套内衬着一个纸箱内部，接着命令威廉和罗伯特去取回希拉的尸体。

sentences.en: Sheila was placed into the cardboard box, which was then loaded into the trunk of Teresa's car.
sentences.zh: 希拉被放进纸箱里，随后被搬进了特蕾莎汽车的后备箱。

sentences.en: For the second time in their life, Robert and William were tasked with helping dispose of one of their sister's bodies.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特和威廉一生中第二次被委派协助处理他们姐姐的尸体。

sentences.en: Terry was forced to stay behind and clean up.
sentences.zh: 特里则被迫留下来打扫卫生。

sentences.en: As she scrubbed away at the dark, foul liquids that had seeped into the closet floor, Terry's mind raced.
sentences.zh: 当特里用力擦洗着渗入储藏室地板的黑色恶臭液体时，她的大脑飞速运转。

sentences.en: As the last remaining daughter, would she be the next to die?
sentences.zh: 作为家中仅存的女儿，她会是下一个死者吗？

sentences.en: That night, Teresa watched as William and Robert dug a grave for Sheila outside the town of Truckee.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，特蕾莎看着威廉和罗伯特在特拉基镇外为希拉挖了一个坟墓。

sentences.en: All of a sudden, a police cruiser pulled up behind them.
sentences.zh: 突然，一辆警车停在他们身后。

sentences.en: William was certain they had been caught and was relieved to think that their nightmare would finally be over.
sentences.zh: 威廉确信他们已经被抓了，甚至感到一丝解脱，觉得他们的噩梦终于要结束了。

sentences.en: By pure chance, neither officer picked up on what was going on and soon left.
sentences.zh: 纯属巧合的是，两名警官并没有察觉到发生了什么，不久便离开了。

sentences.en: Teresa's luck continued when Sheila's body was found.
sentences.zh: 特蕾莎的运气在希拉的尸体被发现时还在继续。

sentences.en: Authorities incorrectly linked her murder to Herbert Boyle, the killer of Gail Smith.
sentences.zh: 当局错误地将她的谋杀案与盖尔·史密斯的凶手赫伯特·博伊尔联系在了一起。

sentences.en: At this point, both Sheila and Susan had been named Jane Doe's, as their isolated life ensured no one could identify their remains.
sentences.zh: 此时，希拉和苏珊都被当作无名尸体处理，因为她们与世隔绝的生活确保了无人能够辨认她们的遗骸。

sentences.en: As far as Teresa was concerned, she had gotten away with everything.
sentences.zh: 就特蕾莎而言，她已经逃脱了所有的罪责。

sentences.en: Just after 3am on September 29, 1986, 16-year-old Terry Knorr emptied three cans of lighter fluid throughout her family's North Sacramento apartment.
sentences.zh: 1986年9月29日凌晨3点刚过，16岁的特里·克诺尔在家人位于北萨克拉门托的公寓里倒了三罐打火机油。

sentences.en: Checking once more that her escape path was clear, she lit a match.
sentences.zh: 再次确认逃生路线畅通后，她划燃了一根火柴。

sentences.en: With shaking hands, she slowly lowered it to the floor.
sentences.zh: 她颤抖着双手，缓缓将火柴放到地板上。

sentences.en: The fire took hold much quicker than Terry anticipated.
sentences.zh: 火势蔓延的速度比特里预期的要快得多。

sentences.en: She leapt out a window just as flames began climbing the walls.
sentences.zh: 就在火焰开始顺着墙壁向上蔓延时，她从窗户跳了出去。

sentences.en: While running from the scene, Terry passed several fire engines on their way to tackle the inferno.
sentences.zh: 在逃离现场时，特里与几辆赶去扑灭大火的消防车擦肩而过。

sentences.en: She reached a hotel room, where her mother was waiting.
sentences.zh: 她来到了一间酒店房间，她的母亲正在那里等候。

sentences.en: The fire had been Teresa's idea.
sentences.zh: 这场火灾是特蕾莎的主意。

sentences.en: She had grown paranoid over a lasting stain in the linen closet, fearing it would link her to Sheila's murder.
sentences.zh: 她对储藏室里洗不掉的污渍产生了偏执的恐惧，生怕这会让她与希拉的谋杀案联系起来。

sentences.en: She had convinced Terry to start the blaze, promising her only remaining daughter that she could move out if she went through with it.
sentences.zh: 她游说特里放火，并向她仅存的女儿承诺，只要她完成这件事就可以搬出去住。

sentences.en: Terry accepted the offer.
sentences.zh: 特里接受了这个提议。

sentences.en: As her sons had since left her of their own accord, Teresa relocated to Salt Lake City in Utah, where she underwent a complete makeover.
sentences.zh: 由于儿子们已经自愿离她而去，特蕾莎搬到了犹他州的盐湖城，并在那里进行了一场彻头彻尾的改头换面。

sentences.en: She became a Mormon and kept herself well-presented with expensive clothes and make-up.
sentences.zh: 她成为了一名摩门教徒，用昂贵的衣服和妆容把自己收拾得精精致致。

sentences.en: She also cut her long, dark hair and began sporting a blonde wig.
sentences.zh: 她还剪短了长长的黑发，开始戴上金色的假发。

sentences.en: With the remainder of her children either literally or metaphorically dead to her, it was time for Teresa to start a new life.
sentences.zh: 随着其余的孩子在现实或名义上对她而言都已经死去，特里莎是时候开始新生活了。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 案卷档案节目稍后回归。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期赞助商广告来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您也在支持案卷档案继续为您带来优质内容。

sentences.en: Susan Knorr and Sheila Sanders were the only two of Teresa's six children to be murdered.
sentences.zh: 苏珊·克诺尔和希拉·桑德斯是特蕾莎六个孩子中仅有的两个被谋杀的孩子。

sentences.en: Yet, the remaining four – Howard, William, Robert and Terry – would struggle from the abuses they had endured at her hands for the rest of their lives.
sentences.zh: 然而，剩下的四个孩子——霍华德、威廉、罗伯特和特里——将在余生中一直与遭受她虐待的阴影作斗争。

sentences.en: Eldest Howard Sanders was the first to leave home and did so before the murders took place.
sentences.zh: 长子霍华德·桑德斯是第一个离家的人，他在谋杀案发生前就离开了。

sentences.en: One day, Howard read a newspaper article about the Jane Doe found burned to death at Squaw Creek.
sentences.zh: 有一天，霍华德读到了一篇关于在斯阔克里克被焚尸灭迹的无名女尸的报纸文章。

sentences.en: Certain it was his sister Susan, he asked his mother where she was.
sentences.zh: 他确信那是他的姐姐苏珊，于是问母亲她在哪儿。

sentences.en: Teresa said Susan had run away and claimed Sheila had too.
sentences.zh: 特蕾莎说苏珊离家出走了，并声称希拉也是如此。

sentences.en: Although Howard didn't believe her, he feared she would kill him as well, so he didn't press the matter.
sentences.zh: 尽管霍华德不相信她，但他害怕母亲也会杀了自己，所以没有再追问此事。

sentences.en: Over the years, Howard struggled to hold down work.
sentences.zh: 多年来，霍华德很难保住一份工作。

sentences.en: Ford Addiction had several run-ins with the law and his marriage ended in divorce.
sentences.zh: 福特·阿迪逊曾数次触犯法律，他的婚姻也以离婚告终。

sentences.en: At 17, William Knorr was the next to move out, leaving between the murders of Susan and Sheila.
sentences.zh: 17岁的威廉·克诺尔是下一个搬出去的人，他在苏珊和希拉被谋杀的间隙离开了家。

sentences.en: He was summoned back home to help with disposing of Sheila's body and did so out of fear of his mother.
sentences.zh: 他被传唤回家里帮忙处理希拉的尸体，这么做完全是出于对母亲的恐惧。

sentences.en: Drugs and alcohol dulled the recurring nightmares William experienced, enough to help him maintain a marriage and job.
sentences.zh: 毒品和酒精麻痹了威廉挥之不去的噩梦，勉强帮他维持了婚姻和工作。

sentences.en: Despite his troubles, he was a friendly and amiable man working hard to get his life on track.
sentences.zh: 尽管历经磨难，他依然是一个友好随和的人，努力让生活重回正轨。

sentences.en: In the book Mother's Day by Dennis McDougall, William reflected on his family, saying,
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯·麦克杜格尔在书《母亲节》中回忆起他的家庭时说道：

sentences.en: Robert Knorr remained living with his mother until her move to Salt Lake City, where he left her soon after.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·克诺尔一直和母亲住在一起，直到她搬到盐湖城，不久之后他也离开了她。

sentences.en: Like his brothers, he sought reprieve from his childhood memories through the use of drugs and alcohol.
sentences.zh: 和他的兄弟们一样，他试图通过吸毒和酗酒来从童年记忆中寻求喘息。

sentences.en: After a string of arrests, he was jailed for burglary and took the opportunity to earn his high school equivalency diploma to expand his employment prospects upon his release.
sentences.zh: 在经历了一连串逮捕后，他因入室盗窃入狱，并借此机会获得了高中同等学力证书，以拓展出狱后的就业前景。

sentences.en: However, his newfound freedom didn't last long.
sentences.zh: 然而，他新获得的自由并没有持续多久。

sentences.en: 22-year-old Robert was sentenced to a further 15 years in prison for the second-degree murder of a bartender shot dead during a robbery.
sentences.zh: 22岁的罗伯特因在抢劫过程中枪杀一名调酒师而被判犯有二级谋杀罪，并被判处另外15年监禁。

sentences.en: He narrowly avoided a murder conviction and the death penalty by cutting a deal with the prosecution to testify against his co-accused.
sentences.zh: 他通过与控方达成认罪协议，出庭指证同案被告，险险逃脱了谋杀定罪和死刑。

sentences.en: Teresa kept her word with youngest daughter, Terry.
sentences.zh: 特蕾莎信守了对小女儿特里的承诺。

sentences.en: After she had started the fire that consumed their North Sacramento apartment, Terry was finally free to live her own life.
sentences.zh: 在放火烧毁他们位于北萨克拉门托的公寓后，特里终于重获自由，去过属于自己的生活。

sentences.en: Her experiences from then onwards mirrored those of her siblings.
sentences.zh: 她自那以后的经历与她的兄弟姐妹们如出一辙。

sentences.en: Adding to her turmoil was the discovery that she was unlikely to conceive the children she desperately wanted due to the severe beatings she suffered throughout her youth.
sentences.zh: 雪上加霜的是，由于年轻时遭受过残酷殴打，她发现自己极难怀上梦寐以求的孩子，这让她备受煎熬。

sentences.en: Terry had also endured childhood sexual abuse.
sentences.zh: 特里在童年时期还遭受过性虐待。

sentences.en: In 1993, her oldest brother Howard admitted to authorities that he had molested Terry when she was six and he was 13.
sentences.zh: 1993年，她的长兄霍华德向当局承认，当特里6岁、他13岁时，他对特里实施了猥亵。

sentences.en: Howard faced no repercussions for these actions.
sentences.zh: 霍华德这些行为没有受到任何惩罚。

sentences.en: Over the years, Terry confided in friends about her childhood, including the murders of her sisters.
sentences.zh: 多年来，特里曾向朋友们倾诉过自己的童年，包括她姐妹们的谋杀案。

sentences.en: Few believed her, and those that did encouraged her to speak to police, who ultimately dismissed her story as far-fetched.
sentences.zh: 没几个人相信她，而相信她的人则鼓励她报警，但警方最终以离奇为由驳回了她的说法。

sentences.en: On one occasion, a sheriff took interest in Terry's allegations and interviewed her.
sentences.zh: 有一次，一位治安官对特里的指控产生了兴趣并对她进行了采访。

sentences.en: A detective was then assigned to investigate whether any unsolved homicides could be linked to Teresa Knorr.
sentences.zh: 随后，一名侦探被指派调查是否有任何未破的凶杀案可以与特蕾莎·克诺尔联系起来。

sentences.en: He concluded there were none, and Terry was once again brushed off.
sentences.zh: 他得出结论认为没有，特里再次被敷衍了事。

sentences.en: More than once, Terry tried to end her pain by taking her own life.
sentences.zh: 特里曾不止一次试图通过自杀来结束自己的痛苦。

sentences.en: Then one night, her outlook changed.
sentences.zh: 直到有一天晚上，她的情况发生了转变。

sentences.en: In the last week of October 1993, 23-year-old Terry Knorr sat on a sofa blinking back tears.
sentences.zh: 1993年10月的最后一周，23岁的特里·克诺尔坐在沙发上，眨着眼睛强忍泪水。

sentences.en: She had just had an argument with her husband, who accused her of lying once again about her sister's murders.
sentences.zh: 她刚刚和丈夫吵了一架，丈夫指责她又一次对她姐妹的谋杀案撒谎。

sentences.en: Terry's attention was drawn to the television screen before her, where a suited man spoke solemnly towards the camera.
sentences.zh: 特里的注意力被眼前的电视屏幕吸引了，一个穿着西装的男人正对着镜头面色凝重地说话。

sentences.en: It was John Walsh, the host of America's Most Wanted.
sentences.zh: 那是《全美通缉令》节目的主持人约翰·沃尔什。

sentences.en: The series reported on unsolved crimes or wanted fugitives, while requesting viewers to offer their tips and insights via a toll-free phone number.
sentences.zh: 该系列节目报道未破悬案或在逃通缉犯，同时呼吁观众通过免费热线电话提供线索和见解。

sentences.en: Terry watched intently and made a decision.
sentences.zh: 特里聚精会神地看着，并做出一个决定。

sentences.en: She grabbed for the telephone and dialed the show's tip line.
sentences.zh: 她抓起电话，拨打了节目的线索热线。

sentences.en: A woman on the other line listened as Terry revisited the story of her sister's murders.
sentences.zh: 电话那头的女人听着特里再次讲述她姐妹被谋杀的故事。

sentences.en: To her disappointment, Terry was told there was nothing the show could do for her.
sentences.zh: 令她失望的是，特里被告知节目组无能为力。

sentences.en: Exhausted by the lack of help and support from all ends, Terry broke down sobbing.
sentences.zh: 由于各方缺乏帮助和支持，特里精疲力竭，失声痛哭。

sentences.en: Yet, unlike others, the woman who answered the call didn't dismiss Terry entirely.
sentences.zh: 然而，与其他人不同的是，接听电话的女人并没有完全打发特里。

sentences.en: She suggested that Terry contact the county authorities where the murders took place.
sentences.zh: 她建议特里联系谋杀案发生所在县的当局。

sentences.en: Sergeant John Fitzgerald at the Placer County Sheriff's substation in Tahoe City took Terry's call.
sentences.zh: 太浩城普莱瑟县治安官分局的约翰·菲茨杰拉德警长接听了特里的电话。

sentences.en: While detailing Susan's murder, Terry referenced an antique wedding ring her sister had been wearing when set alight at Squire Creek.
sentences.zh: 在详述苏珊谋杀案的过程中，特里提到了一枚古董结婚戒指，那是她姐姐在斯奎尔溪被点燃焚烧时佩戴的。

sentences.en: Sergeant Fitzgerald's interest was already piqued.
sentences.zh: 菲茨杰拉德警长的兴趣已经被激起了。

sentences.en: But the ring mansion really drew his attention.
sentences.zh: 但真正引起他注意的是那枚戒指的细节。

sentences.en: Shaking with emotion, Terry explained how no one believed her story about her mother, not even her husband.
sentences.zh: 特里情绪激动地颤抖着，解释说没有人相信她关于母亲的故事，连她丈夫也不信。

sentences.en: Sergeant Fitzgerald responded,
sentences.zh: 菲茨杰拉德警长回应道：

sentences.en: Young lady, if it's any consolation to you, you can tell your husband this.
sentences.zh: 年轻姑娘，如果这能给你一点安慰的话，你可以把这话告诉你丈夫。

sentences.en: I found a 17-year-old female burning near Squire Creek on July 17, 1984.
sentences.zh: 1984年7月17日，我在斯奎尔溪附近发现了一具被焚烧的17岁女性尸体。

sentences.en: I believe she was your sister.
sentences.zh: 我相信她就是你的姐姐。

sentences.en: Ten days after Terry's call,
sentences.zh: 在特里打完电话十天后，

sentences.en: Sergeant John Fitzgerald arrived on the doorstep of a modest, low-set home in East Salt Lake City.
sentences.zh: 约翰·菲茨杰拉德警长来到了东盐湖城一栋朴素的低层住宅门前。

sentences.en: An older lady named Mrs Cross answered the door.
sentences.zh: 一位名叫克罗斯太太的老妇人开了门。

sentences.en: She was the live-in carer for the home's owner, an elderly woman named Alice Sullivan.
sentences.zh: 她是这栋房子业主、一位名叫爱丽丝·沙利文的老妇人的住家护工。

sentences.en: Sergeant Fitzgerald looked at the photograph in his hands of Teresa Knorr, then eyed the haggard and pale woman standing before him.
sentences.zh: 菲茨杰拉德警长看着手里的特蕾莎·克诺尔的照片，然后打量着眼前这个憔悴苍白的女人。

sentences.en: She invited them inside.
sentences.zh: 她邀请他们进屋。

sentences.en: The search for Teresa Knorr had not been an easy one, as she had gone by many surnames throughout her life.
sentences.zh: 寻找特蕾莎·克诺尔并不容易，因为她一生中用过许多姓氏。

sentences.en: Mrs Cross was initially reluctant to admit to anything, but eventually revealed that she was going by her maiden name.
sentences.zh: 克罗斯太太起初不愿承认任何事情，但最终透露她用的是自己的娘家姓。

sentences.en: Her actual name was Teresa Knorr.
sentences.zh: 她的真名是特蕾莎·克诺尔。

sentences.en: Teresa remained calm when shown the warrant for her arreSt.
sentences.zh: 当被出示逮捕令时，特蕾莎表现得很平静。

sentences.en: Teresa then contacted Alice's son and informed him that she was being arrested.
sentences.zh: 随后，特蕾莎联系了爱丽丝的儿子，并通知他自己被捕了。

sentences.en: Knowing his mother's nurse as nothing but a kind-hearted and generous individual, he was stunned at the news and asked why.
sentences.zh: 由于他心目中的母亲护工一直是个善良大方的人，他听到这个消息感到震惊，并追问原因。

sentences.en: Teresa said she didn't know.
sentences.zh: 特蕾莎说她不知道。

sentences.en: When it came time to take Teresa Knorr into custody,
sentences.zh: 当轮到将特蕾莎·克诺尔拘留时，

sentences.en: Sergeant Fitzgerald found her trying to escape via a rear door of the house.
sentences.zh: 菲茨杰拉德警长发现她正试图从房子的后门逃跑。

sentences.en: I feel like a sacrificial lamb being led to the slaughter, she told him.
sentences.zh: 我感觉自己像是一只待宰的替罪羔羊，她对他说。

sentences.en: Investigators soon arrived at Teresa's former North Sacramento apartment.
sentences.zh: 调查人员很快抵达了特蕾莎以前在北萨克拉门托的公寓。

sentences.en: Luckily for them, the arson Terry committed years prior didn't do as much damage as Teresa had hoped.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，特里多年前纵火造成的破坏并没有特蕾莎希望的那么严重。

sentences.en: Once inside, officers came across a small closet in the hallway.
sentences.zh: 进门后，警官们偶然发现了门厅里的一个小壁橱。

sentences.en: Sergeant Fitzgerald's stomach churned.
sentences.zh: 菲茨杰拉德警长胃里一阵翻江倒海。

sentences.en: According to Terry, Sheila had been locked inside the closet, but the door in front of him didn't have a lock.
sentences.zh: 根据特里的说法，希拉曾被锁在这个壁橱里，但他眼前的门却没有锁。

sentences.en: Sergeant Fitzgerald began to worry.
sentences.zh: 菲茨杰拉德警长开始担心起来。

sentences.en: Had Terry lied to him?
sentences.zh: 特里对他说谎了吗？

sentences.en: He phoned her to clarify.
sentences.zh: 他打电话向她核实。
